title: Scaffold Manifest
description: Authoritative list of scaffold files the currently installed generator produces, with their template versions. Generated at build time and committed to dist-templates/.

framework_version.description: Vault-wide infrastructure counter. Bumps only when infrastructure layer changes.

generator_commit.description: Git SHA of the generator at the time the manifest was built.

template_version.description: Independent per-file counter. Bumps only when this template's rendered output changes.

rendered_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalised rendered content.

is_user_owned_after_first_write.description: When true, the migrator creates the file if missing but never upgrades it (user accretes content after creation, e.g. data_vault index files).
